purpose: Preregistration of the POST battery: configurations, fixtures, expectations and the planned invocation count are frozen BEFORE any POST measurement. No criterion changes after an outcome for the sake of a PASS.
principle: Every named case records MEASURED_QUANTITY, EXPECTED, ACTUAL, DENOMINATOR, SOURCE_OF_TRUTH, NEGATIVE_CONTROL, FAILURE_CASE_DETECTED, RESULT. Where no denominator exists the field is NOT_APPLICABLE with a unit — no number is invented. Expected rejection of a mutant is TEST_PASS/CONTROL_PASS, not a science PASS.
